elements.name: Change magnification with the mouse wheel

steps.name: a rectangular block is visible in an active part in the MCAD Software
no navigation command is active
the user scrolls the mouse wheel over the block in the direction that zooms out
the block appears smaller in the viewport
the same part and orientation remain active
the user scrolls the mouse wheel over the block in the opposite direction
the block appears larger than after zooming out
the same part and orientation remain active

elements.name: Activate and cancel Zoom from the navigation bar

steps.name: a part containing a visible solid is active in the MCAD Software
the viewport navigation bar is visible
the user selects Zoom on the navigation bar
Zoom is active
the Zoom control is highlighted
the status area prompts for zooming and indicates cancellation is available
the active part and solid remain visible
the user presses Escape
the status area displays Ready
the active part and solid remain visible

elements.name: Fit a distant block using Zoom All

steps.name: a rectangular block is active in the MCAD Software
the block appears small within the viewport
the user opens the Zoom menu on the navigation bar
the menu offers Zoom, Zoom All, Zoom Window and Zoom Selected
the user chooses Zoom All
the block appears larger and its visible outline fits within the viewport
the same part and orientation remain active
the user reopens the Zoom menu
Zoom All is marked as the selected action
the user selects Zoom and presses Escape
the status area displays Ready
a rectangular block is active in the MCAD Software
its visible face occupies most of the viewport with its outline visible
the user chooses Zoom Window from the navigation bar Zoom menu
the status area prompts for a zoom window
the user clicks one corner within the visible face
the user clicks an opposite corner within that face
the view zooms into the chosen area
the face extends beyond the viewport
the status area displays Ready
the same part and orientation remain active
the user reopens the Zoom menu
Zoom Window is marked as the selected action
the user chooses Zoom All and then restores Zoom as the selected action
the user presses Escape
the status area displays Ready
a rectangular block is active in the MCAD Software
its visible planar face appears small within the viewport
the face is selected
the user chooses Zoom Selected from the navigation bar Zoom menu
the selected face appears larger and fills most of the viewport
the face remains selected
the same part and orientation remain active
the status area displays Ready
the user reopens the Zoom menu
Zoom Selected is marked as the selected action
the user selects Zoom and presses Escape
the status area displays Ready

elements.name: Choose a face after starting Zoom Selected

steps.name: a rectangular block is active in the MCAD Software
its visible planar face appears small within the viewport
no model entity is selected
the user chooses Zoom Selected from the navigation bar Zoom menu
the status area prompts the user to select an entity to zoom
the user clicks the visible planar face
the face appears larger and fills most of the viewport
the face is no longer highlighted as selected
the status area displays Ready
the same part and orientation remain active

elements.name: Cancel a zoom window after its first corner

steps.name: a rectangular block is active in the MCAD Software
its visible planar face occupies most of the viewport
the user chooses Zoom Window from the navigation bar Zoom menu
the user clicks a first corner within the face
the user presses Escape before choosing the opposite corner
the status area displays Ready
the face retains its previous apparent size and position
the same part and orientation remain active
